readmeExcerpt: This sample shows the smallest useful pattern for storing Java `UUID` primary keys in Oracle AI Database with plain JDBC.
highlights: Java UUID values can be stored compactly as RAW(16) primary keys.
The conversion is explicit and bit-preserving.
JDBC can bind and read the value as bytes without string formatting.
A Testcontainers integration test verifies the stored RAW value is exactly 16 bytes and round-trips to the original UUID.
metaTitle: JDBC UUID Primary Keys | Oracle AI Database Code Samples
metaDescription: Plain JDBC sample that stores Java UUID primary keys as RAW(16) values in Oracle AI Database.
